B0D2TDCYGC.variant: Pink; inspected Medium, choose individual size from measurements
B0D2TDCYGC.why_selected: The soft dusty pink, open polo collar and cable texture supply the feminine preppy detail. Its relaxed shape works with a small front tuck into denim; no need for a matching pink skirt or decorative accessories.

B0DQ9SZP5J.name: Lee Legendary denim skirt
B0DQ9SZP5J.variant: Best in Show (light blue); inspected size 8, choose individual size from measurements
B0DQ9SZP5J.materials: 99% cotton, 1% spandex; zipper/button closure; five pockets
B0DQ9SZP5J.why_selected: A straightforward denim skirt gives the textured pink knit a wearable casual base. The lighter blue and white sneakers keep it fresh. Straight below-knee shape, real pockets and a back walking slit; no synthetic school-uniform skirt or fussy pleats.
B0DQ9SZP5J.limitations: Visible verified buyers in this colour praised denim quality and wearability. Waist sizing gets mixed feedback, so use actual measurements. Below-knee length; do not turn it into a mini. Physical wear not tested.
B0DQ9SZP5J.evidence: Selected Best in Show retail photograph, material, seller, offer and customer review text inspected 7 October 2026. Listing centre-front measurement 27 3/8 inches. In Stock for inspected size 8.
